title: Current Web Authority Admission
purpose: Apply the existing Current Web Authority runtime to W8B source-bounded claim candidates and produce governed Current Evidence IR without creating derived runtime readings or positions.
rules: authorityClassHint from W8B is not authority admission and cannot be silently promoted.
Each CWA-ready claim requires an explicit authority/domain decision before source admission is attempted.
Freshness is evaluated by the canonical Current Web Authority runtime at the W8C production time.
Only CWA ADMITTED sources may create Current Evidence IR.
Conflict groups are resolved by CWA authority precedence and never by source-count voting.
UNKNOWN_CONFLICTED evidence remains auditable but is blocked from RRE-eligible handoff.
PARTIAL support may be admitted as evidence but does not enter RRE-eligible handoff.
RRE-eligible handoff requires DIRECT support and a non-conflicted selected evidence outcome.
W8C does not infer grammar, reality domain, Phase, current position, transition, threshold or projection.
